ui.agents.pages.back_to_list.note: Returns to the roster on widths where the list and the detail pane do not fit together. Sentence case, one short line beside a left arrow that mirrors in RTL.
ui.agents.pages.back_to_list.role: button label in the narrow-width back bar

ui.agents.pages.browse_aria.note: Says what the two tabs switch between: definitions of different kinds. No visible label, so this is the only name the group has.
ui.agents.pages.browse_aria.role: accessible name for the tab list

ui.agents.pages.discard_bar.agent.note: Names the record type the unsaved edits belong to; the team variant is the sibling message. The bar's accessible name is the shared discard question.
ui.agents.pages.discard_bar.agent.role: question in an alertdialog bar above the pane

ui.agents.pages.discard_bar.team.note: Team counterpart of discard_bar.agent; keep the two parallel so the sentence differs only in its object.
ui.agents.pages.discard_bar.team.role: question in an alertdialog bar above the pane

ui.agents.pages.empty.agents.note: The roster is empty because this machine holds no agent definitions at all. Names the two ways out: the ask box below the list, or the manual add. Sentence case, two short sentences.

ui.agents.pages.empty.builtin.note: The roster is empty because the BUILT-IN filter is on and every built-in definition was filtered out by the search. Short by design: it sits in a narrow list column. Keeps the hyphen English puts in 'built-in'; don't assume it in the target language.
ui.agents.pages.empty.builtin.role: empty-state sentence in the roster, built-in scope

ui.agents.pages.empty.custom.note: The roster is empty because the CUSTOM filter is on: definitions created or edited on this machine. Short, same slot as the other scope variants.
ui.agents.pages.empty.custom.role: empty-state sentence in the filtered agents roster

ui.agents.pages.empty.installed.note: The roster is empty because the INSTALLED filter is on: definitions fetched from the hub. Keep 'installed' distinct from 'custom' and 'built-in', which the sibling sentences use.
ui.agents.pages.empty.installed.role: empty-state sentence in the filtered agents roster

ui.agents.pages.empty.search.note: The roster is empty because the search matched nothing. {query} is the text the reader typed, quoted with curly quotes U+201C and U+201D; a locale may swap them for its own pair (for example French guillemets), so re-quote rather than keep the English marks.
ui.agents.pages.empty.search.role: empty-state sentence in the roster, search matched nothing

ui.agents.pages.empty.teams.note: The teams half of the roster is empty. Sibling of empty.agents; keep the two parallel so they differ only in their noun.
ui.agents.pages.empty.teams.role: empty-state sentence in the teams roster

ui.agents.pages.heading.note: Names both halves of the surface, because the page lists agents and teams. Sentence case; a narrow sidebar column (288 px) bounds it.

ui.agents.pages.loading_saved.note: Shown while a saved agent's route loads its legacy page. U+2026 rather than three periods.

ui.agents.pages.scope.all.note: One of four segments: every definition regardless of origin. Short by design - four segments share one row.
ui.agents.pages.scope.all.role: segment label in the ownership scope group

ui.agents.pages.scope.builtin.note: Definitions that ship with the app. Hyphenated in English; don't assume the hyphen in other locales.
ui.agents.pages.scope.builtin.role: segment label in the ownership scope group

ui.agents.pages.scope.custom.note: Definitions created or edited on this machine. Same row as the other three scope segments, so keep it short.
ui.agents.pages.scope.custom.role: segment label in the ownership scope group

ui.agents.pages.scope.installed.note: Definitions fetched from the hub. Distinguished from 'Built-in' and 'Custom'; keep the three terms distinct in the target language.
ui.agents.pages.scope.installed.role: segment label in the ownership scope group

ui.agents.pages.scope_legend.note: The group has no visible label, so this names what the four segments choose: who owns the definition. Ends the sentence the segments complete.
ui.agents.pages.scope_legend.role: screen-reader legend for the scope group

ui.agents.pages.search.agents.note: Placeholder in the roster search input when agents are listed. The accessible name is search_aria and does not change with the tab.

ui.agents.pages.search.teams.note: Placeholder when teams are listed. Pairs with search.agents; both must fit the same input width.
ui.agents.pages.search.teams.role: placeholder in the roster search input, teams tab

ui.agents.pages.search_aria.note: Stable across both tabs, so it names both record kinds even when one is shown. Do not make it tab-dependent: the name must not change under focus.
ui.agents.pages.search_aria.role: accessible name for the roster search input

ui.agents.pages.tab.agents.note: Half of the two-tab switch between agents and teams. A live count sits beside it in a two-character slot, so keep the word short.

ui.agents.pages.tab.teams.note: The other half of the agent/team switch; pairs with tab.agents and shares its count slot.
